One addition, on top of [1.4](https://github.com/Diffechento/MetroMusic/releases/tag/v1.4). Built on
the same [MangoTile 1.0.4](https://github.com/Diffechento/MangoTile/releases/tag/v1.0.4); nothing else
in the app has changed.

**An artist's albums can be read from the start as well as from the end.** The order on an artist's
page — settings → interface — offered newest first or the alphabet. **Oldest first** is the third
answer, for anyone who reads a discography forwards rather than backwards.

An album whose tags carry no year still goes last under *both* directions. Undated is not "the year
zero", and an ordinary ascending sort would have opened the page with exactly the records nobody
dated, which is the one thing "oldest first" is not asking for.

---

The APK carries the same signing certificate as every release since 1.0 (`SHA-256
494018a9…2acf7c09`), so it installs over any of them as an update and keeps your settings,
favourites, play counts and queue.

minSdk 26 · compileSdk 36 · GPLv3 · third-party notices are in the app, on settings → about.
